html:
Young Com, a specialty of Hanoi’s autumn, is one of the famous specialties. In the autumn weather, you can enjoy the scenery while enjoying lemon tea, egg coffee and young Com, there is nothing more interesting.

Although Com is a rustic dish, it has a strong traditional flavor of Vietnamese culture. Unlike Com from the Northwest, Ha Thanh Com is often processed into many dishes such as sticky rice with lotus seeds and green beans, Com sausage, fried Com…

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Hanoi, you should visit the street food stalls or coffee shops in the corners of Hanoi to enjoy young Com while admiring the scenery of Hanoi.

Especially in the autumn weather, visitors can enjoy Com with glasses of lemon tea, kumquat tea or egg coffee… which is one of the Hanoi cuisines that has a strong traditional culinary background but is also very new to young people.

Many restaurants in Hanoi have caught up with the trend of young people, with young rice on their menus, such as dishes made from green rice, such as green rice, sticky rice or stir-fried green rice, a typical culinary background of Hanoi’s autumn.

Not only that, after enjoying the meal, customers can also buy green rice cakes as gifts, or enjoy green rice coconut smoothies, matcha green rice… which further enriches the culinary background, and diners also feel more excited.

So if you have the opportunity to visit Hanoi in the fall, enjoy green rice, a famous specialty, and don’t forget to buy some as gifts for friends and relatives.
